rationale: Slow local rise and long settling describe how quickly stage outputs stabilize. They do not establish how long improvements take to appear end to end: an improvement could become visible before the stage settles. The mapping supplies no empirical relation connecting these local response times to delayed end-to-end improvement.
signal_basis:
- Rise: how quickly a stage's queue, waiting time or completion rate moves toward its new level.
- Settling: the time until the output stays inside the pre-set band.
